title: Einfache gebrochen rationale Funktionen untersuchen
description: Die lernende Person kann grundlegende Eigenschaften einfacher gebrochen rationaler Funktionen der Form $f(x)=\frac{1}{x^n}$ beschreiben, Definitions- und Wertemenge sowie Graphenmerkmale angeben und das Verhalten an Polstellen und im Unendlichen deuten.
checks: The formulas, stated domains/ranges, quadrants and limiting behaviour of 1/x and 1/x² are correct.
defects: In the 1/x² panel the unit tick immediately left of the vertical axis is labelled positive 1 instead of −1.

That negative x-axis shows equally spaced ticks labelled −4, −2 and 1, which is not a consistent linear scale. The labelled point (−2,0.25) also sits between the pictured −4 and −2 ticks instead of above −2.
nextAction: Retain the explanatory content and correct the right coordinate plot: a uniform x scale with −2,−1,0,1,2, and points (±1,1),(±2,0.25) aligned with their ticks. Do not change the domains, ranges or asymptote statements.
